---
title: "Coding Sandbox"
subtitle: "Build a graph from using Python code"
---

Use the toolbar to add nodes and edges, select a node or edge by clicking it,
then update or delete the current selection. This is the same graph engine
and canvas used throughout the rest of the site -- everything you learn here
carries over.

```{python}
#| echo: false
initial_nodes = [
    {"id": "A", "label": "A"},
    {"id": "B", "label": "B"},
    {"id": "C", "label": "C"},
]
initial_edges = [
    {"id": "e0", "source": "A", "target": "B", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e1", "source": "B", "target": "C", "label": ""},
]

ojs_define(sb_nodes = initial_nodes, sb_edges = initial_edges)
```

::: {.panel}
<div id="sandbox-graph"></div>
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { GraphEngine } from "./js/graph-engine.js";
import { mountGraphView } from "./js/graph-view.js";

sandboxData = ({
  nodes: sb_nodes,
  edges: sb_edges,
});

sandboxEngine = new GraphEngine(sandboxData, { directed: false });
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sandboxView = mountGraphView(sandboxEngine, document.querySelector("#sandbox-graph"), {
  width: 760,
  height: 460,
});
```
